title: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI: visual workflows for generative media
friendlyTitle: ComfyUI: build visual AI media workflows
summary: ComfyUI is a widely used node-based interface and backend for constructing image, video and audio generation pipelines. The actively maintained project has about 125,000 GitHub stars and supports reusable graphs, local models, an API and a large extension ecosystem.
friendlySummary: ComfyUI lets you connect boxes on a graph to control how AI creates and edits images, video and audio.
whyItMatters: Creators and developers can build repeatable media workflows by connecting model loading, prompting, control and post-processing nodes instead of hiding the process behind one prompt. Start with trusted templates and review third-party nodes before installing them.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it for repeatable creative workflows on your own computer. Check community add-ons before installing them.
